contract.question: For the eleven route-named therapeutic addresses already read in EMC tissue, which EMC-versus-other-sarcoma expression directions survive deleting any one EMC sample or any one comparator histology?
contract.stop_condition: Deliver a deterministic script, JSON result, concise methods/results note and behavioral tests covering every named address on each recorded platform, including unreadable and unstable results. Stop after independent arithmetic verification; no manuscript or new broad review.

clinical_relevance.basis: Existing RT-FAP-RLT and PUB-SURFACE-TARGETS route questions concern candidate tissue addresses; this can prioritize later validation, not treatment.

answerability.basis: Committed emc-expression-panels.json includes per-sample z values, labels and platform coverage for the eleven addresses.

validation.basis: Exact deletion arithmetic can be independently recomputed; compare baseline means to the committed parent artifact within its rounding precision.

information_gain.basis: Current cross-platform board summarizes direction without single-sample or comparator-histology sensitivity for these eleven addresses. A fragile or unreadable result is useful.

contract.instructions: Use the existing surface_antigen.groups.route_named_addresses membership: CD276, SSTR2, PRAME, FAP, CD248, CSPG4, MSLN, L1CAM, GPC3, ALPP, CDH17. Use only gene_reads per_sample z_vs_array, class and gsm from the committed parent JSON. Preserve the parent input SHA256 and exact source path. Analyse each platform independently: baseline mean(EMC)-mean(all non-EMC); every leave-one-EMC-out delta; every leave-one-comparator-histology-out delta, provided both arms remain nonempty. Report sample counts, comparator class counts, min/max deletion deltas, sign flips and missingness. Include all deletion rows so arithmetic is auditable. No p-values, confidence intervals, probability claims or cross-platform pooling: these are finite sensitivity ranges on rounded parent values, not sampling uncertainty. Compare recomputed baseline to parent welch_EMC_vs_comparator.delta_a_minus_b at the parent's precision and report disagreement rather than silently normalizing it away. Do not claim raw-data or probe-choice validation: parent values already aggregate probes. Flag unreadable platform/address combinations; missing probe does not mean absent expression. The two cohorts contain different comparator mixtures and cannot establish tumour restriction, surface protein localisation, safety or efficacy. PRAME is an intracellular HLA-presented address, not a surface protein; use therapeutic-address wording. Note this is exploratory secondary reanalysis, not a preregistered analysis. Generate a concise Markdown note with valid repository metadata (kind memo, audience maintainers/autonomous research agents) and source links to https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE24369 and https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE4303, verified by coordinator. Focus tests on missing data, sign instability and comparator deletion; don't pin prose. Rerun generator and confirm deterministic identical JSON. No figures needed. No networks, installs or paid compute. For pytest use --basetemp=.cache/surface-sensitivity-tests --tb=short -p no:cacheprovider because the shared Windows pytest temporary directory is not writable. Use runner-supplied Python executable. Stop on a precise missing-input problem if the committed parent cannot support this computation.
